subject: Forecast curation sprint — stage confirmations & leadership pack intake
content:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast curation sprint — stage confirmations & leadership pack intake

Team —

Kicking off the November forecast curation sprint. Goal: get stage-level confirmations and a clean commit list for the leadership review pack. We need this to be tidy by the leadership intake deadline so Finance can bake numbers into the deck. High-level plan below — please read and ack.

Attachments: forecast_curation_template.xlsx (use this to list commit rows), exec_brief_template.pptx (slide template for stage summary)

Action items (owners + deadlines):
- Owners: confirm stage assignments and commit readiness in the attached sheet. Mark rows as COMMIT / AT-RISK / NEEDS-EVAL. (owner: each manager; due: EOD Tue Nov 2)
- Validation sweep: run the validation script (docs in Drive link) and flag any mismatched ACV or PO dates. Upload validation CSV into folder. (owner: Jonas; due: Wed Nov 3 noon PT)
- Exec brief intake: populate the stage-one slides with top 6 commits (owner: Laura; due: Wed Nov 3 4pm PT)
- Escalations & comments: post blockers in the shared doc and @me for quick decisions.

Please do not add provisional commits to the leadership slide — only MARKED COMMIT rows should go in the brief. We will accept at-risk as a separate appendix.

Notes / rules of the cleanroom:
- Only validated commit rows (contract signed / PO received or legal/finance-approved MSA) should be flagged COMMIT.
- If there are timing questions (billing start date mismatch, etc.) add a comment and tag Finance Ops (finance@orbit-analytics.com).
- If an external procurement milestone is outstanding, add that in the note column and cc the account contact.

Timing is tight — if you expect delays, call out the specific deals now so we can decide whether to include them or table to the next cadence.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Plan: run through my stage rows this morning, update the template with COMMIT / AT-RISK / NEEDS-EVAL, and drop the slide bullets into the exec_brief_template by 16:00 PT Wednesday. If anything looks like a forced push (legal or PO delays), I will flag it and tag Finance Ops.

Laura Bennett

Jasmine —

If you have verbal signoff but no PO, mark as AT-RISK. Only convert to COMMIT once we have either a signed contract or a finance-approved PO. For the leadership slide, we will include a short appendix that lists high-probability AT-RISK deals but does not count toward the commit total.

If you think Orbit Analytics' PO will clear before Wed 4pm, call it out in the sheet with the expected PO date and tag finance@orbit-analytics.com so Finance Ops can chase.

Thanks,
Marcus

Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone — updates look good. Laura: I reviewed your initial slide bullets and they read clean. Jonas: appreciated the validation notes; please ensure the three mismatches are corrected or annotated before we finalize.

Final reminders:
- Last upload window for slide-ready COMMIT rows: Wed Nov 3 16:00 PT.
- Any outstanding PO chasing: Finance Ops will send a follow-up to Orbit Analytics (finance@orbit-analytics.com) and Acme procurement contact (acct_mgr@acme.com).
- If you need a quick sync, I'll be available Wed 10:00–11:00 PT for a 15-minute run-through.

I'll assemble the leadership intake folder after close and circulate the final pack by Thu morning.

Marcus
